text.tspan: Nodes and pods in different CIDRs: VPC CNI custom networking / Auto Mode pod subnets
EC2 node (one instance, network interfaces in both subnets)
hostNetwork pods use the node IP
ENIConfig per AZ → pod subnet + SG
• fewer pods per node (eth0 not used)
• only NEW nodes use it: replace old ones
• outside VPC sees the node IP, not pod IP
Why do it: subnets ran out of IPs, pods need different security groups, or pods must stay non-routable
while nodes keep routable IPs for on-prem / Transit Gateway. Debug with: kubectl get nodes -o wide vs kubectl get pods -o wide.
